If a coordinator fails, replicas elect a new leader. Reads can still return old data after the election finishes.

The payment handler prevents duplicate charges only if requests use the original idempotency key. A client timeout does not tell you if the first charge went through. Retrying with a new key is not protected and can create another charge.

Backpressure slows down new incoming requests while the waiting queue clears; it does not cancel requests that were already accepted.
